entries.name: dotnet
entries.purpose: The .NET SDK that global.json pins exactly, with rollForward disable and prereleases disabled. It bundles .NET Runtime 10.0.14, ASP.NET Core Runtime 10.0.14 and C# 14.0, and builds and tests the repository on Linux, Windows and macOS. CI installs only this SDK, from the official archive for each runner that .github/dotnet-sdk.json pins by URL and SHA-512.
entries.reason: D-02 pins exact SDK and dependency versions for each release. CODE-01 pinned 10.0.303, whose runtime 10.0.11 predates three security releases and whose feature band received none of their fixes. This review moves the pin to 10.0.403, the SDK of the out-of-band security release 10.0.14, and makes it exact with rollForward disable. SEC-01 replaced actions/setup-dotnet, which checked downloads only by size and added an unpinned runtime, with an install that verifies each archive's SHA-512 before extraction.

maintenance.ageException: Published 2026-10-25, the day of review, as the SDK of the out-of-band security release 10.0.14. The security exception applies: the pinned runtime 10.0.11 is affected by advisories fixed in 10.0.13 and 10.0.14.
maintenance.maintainer: Microsoft, in the dotnet GitHub organization
maintenance.activity: .NET 10 is an LTS release in active support until 2028-11-14. The 2026-09-08, 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-25 releases ship only 10.0.4xx and 10.0.1xx SDKs. When the pin changed, the channel release metadata still listed 10.0.13 as the latest release; the dotnet/core release record for 10.0.14 lists SDK 10.0.403 and its file hashes, and the archive the Builder downloaded matched them. .github/dotnet-sdk.json copies the URL and SHA-512 of the linux-x64, linux-arm64, osx-x64, osx-arm64, win-x64 and win-arm64 archives from that record, and all six downloads matched on 2026-10-25.
maintenance.advisories: Runtime 10.0.14 includes the fixes of security releases 10.0.12 (6 CVEs), 10.0.13 (44 CVEs, including the critical ASP.NET Core advisories GHSA-rv87-ccxw-8ggf and GHSA-fpq8-4vhr-rcxx) and 10.0.14 (4 CVEs, including CVE-2026-111497 in the Brotli decoder). No advisory affecting 10.0.14 was known at review.

clearance.note: Linux and macOS distributions are MIT. On Windows, coreclr.dll, the native symbol reader and WPF native binaries use the .NET Library License, and the WPF shader compiler uses the Windows SDK License. Modularyn builds with the SDK and does not redistribute it, and compiler output carries no SDK restriction. Review before a release redistributes Windows runtime binaries, such as a Windows self-contained or single-file build.
